prompt: Make a 15-second product launch teaser for 'Lumen', a search app for docs: a bold tagline, then the product name, then the headline number '3x faster search', then a closing line 'Available 12 November'.

Make a 20-second launch video for Lumen with three feature scenes in turn: Instant search, Shared collections and Offline mode, each with a one-line description, ending on a call to action 'Try Lumen free'.

Make a 20-second walkthrough of the pull request 'Add retry to the upload client': a title card with the PR title, then the diff as monospace text lines starting with + and - (two removed lines and three added lines of JavaScript), then a closing card 'Uploads now retry 3 times'.
Make a 20-second walkthrough of a pull request that renames fetchUser to loadUser: a title card, then a code-diff block showing the change in one handler file, then the summary 'Renamed in 14 files'.

Make a 20-second bar chart race of programming language popularity from 2018 to 2024 for Python, JavaScript, Rust and Go: the bars reorder as the year ticks up, with the current year shown large in a corner.
Make a 15-second map video that highlights three regions in turn, Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific, each with a label and a customer count (1,200, 2,400 and 3,100).
Make a 16:9, 12-second social clip with plain captions from data/captions.srt: a bold hook headline near the top and the captions along the bottom.
Make a 9:16, 12-second vertical clip with karaoke captions from data/captions.vtt, data/music.wav as quiet background music, and the title 'Ship faster' at the top.

Turn this short setup guide into a 25-second video, one scene per step: Install (npm install lumen), Configure (add your docs folder to lumen.json), Search (lumen search quickstart). Show each command in a monospace font with its step number.

Turn this FAQ into a 24-second video, one question per scene with the answer appearing below it: 'Does it work offline?' - 'Yes, the index lives on your machine.'; 'Is it free?' - 'Yes, for teams of up to 5 people.'; 'Can I export results?' - 'Yes, as CSV or Markdown.'

Make a 10-second welcome clip for a new customer: the headline 'Welcome, Ada' and the subtitle 'Greetings from London'. Declare name and city as variables, so it can be rendered per row of data/rows.json.

Make a 12-second KPI card clip: the name 'Ada' above a large counter that goes from 0 to 12 with the label 'orders shipped'. Build it as a template, so the same clip can be rendered again for each person in data/rows.json by changing the name and the number.
